title: Caleb Kwon
text:
About
I study how retailers schedule labor. My research uses large-scale administrative data to understand worker and store productivity, the value of algorithmic scheduling tools, and the effects of labor policy.

title: Caleb Kwon
text:
Hiring Research Assistants
I am looking for undergraduate research assistants interested in operations management, data analysis, and AI applications in retail. Strong candidates will have completed coursework in statistics, programming (R or Python), or econometrics.
If interested, please email me with your resume and a brief description of your research interests.
